svg.title: Department budgets, against actuals from real rows — SoftTrack web design mockup (#134)
svg.desc: Finance → Budgets compares each department’s budget for a period with actuals summed from approved payroll lines and reimbursed expenses, per currency. Attribution is frozen at approval; spend with no department lands in a visible Unattributed bucket.
svg.text: Department budgets, against actuals from real rows
· what a department meant to spend, next to what it did
1 Jul – 30 Sep 2026 · signed in as Grace

g.text: Actuals are approved payroll lines plus reimbursed expenses, attributed to the
department a person was in when each was approved. Compared per currency,
One budget per department, period and
currency. Engineering pays in three currencies,
Over budget reads as over budget.
Unattributed is a row, not a filter.
line and 2 expenses had no department when
they were approved. A bucket you can see is a
data-quality prompt; one filtered out is money

svg.text: A budget is a row: department, period, amount, currency

g.text: Any start and end: months, quarters and odd fiscal years are all just rows.
If Omar Farouk moves to Operations in October, his July, August and September lines stay in
Engineering: each line copied his department when it was approved, so a reorg cannot move
past spend. Draft lines and unpaid claims are not actuals yet.

svg.text: A budget row: department, start, end, amount, currency. Finance-admin only, from the Finance section of settings. Actuals are summed in the database from approved payroll
lines and reimbursed expenses, using the department_id each row copied when it froze. No forecasting, encumbrances or ledger.
